issues.problem: Chinese says the Han struck from both sides and 大破赵军 (routed the Zhao army), then killed Chen Yu and captured King Xie; English says they "routed and captured the Zhao army," adding the capture of the whole army, which the Chinese does not state (only the king is said to be taken alive).
issues.suggestion: Change "routed and captured the Zhao army" to "routed the Zhao army".

overall: The two editions match closely in facts, quotes and framing; the only discrepancy is the English addition that the entire Zhao army was captured.
